proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.take_damage_from_creature
proposed_widenings.justification: Hellish Rebuke fires whenever the caster takes damage from a visible creature within range — not just on attack roll hits. The existing 'hit_by_attack_roll' variant is too narrow: it covers melee/ranged attack rolls but not damage from saving throw spells, AoE effects, or other damage sources. A new variant is needed to honestly encode the trigger.
proposed_widenings.evidence: which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself

notes: Everything else fits cleanly: triggered_reaction family, single save_gate phase (DEX vs caster spell save DC), onFail = 2d10 fire damage, onSuccess = half_damage sentinel, linear_per_level slot scaling (+1d10 per slot above 1). The only gap is the trigger shape. The existing 'hit_by_attack_roll' variant would be a dishonest encoding.
